jobs.name: rust (ubuntu-latest)
jobs.failure: Clippy: clippy::field-reassign-with-default at crates/ui-egui/src/lib.rs; initialize NativeOptions with struct-update syntax.

jobs.name: macOS round-trip
jobs.failure: After the explicitly successful Canvas save, exact app-data equality rejected the transaction journal and that operation's incoming/previous recovery records.

jobs.name: Ubuntu round-trip
jobs.failure: GTK created config/gtk-4.0 and data/recently-used.xbel inside recursively monitored XDG roots; the exact app-owned bootstrap entries were otherwise expected.

jobs.name: Windows round-trip
jobs.failure: The first app.ron appeared after Canvas draft editing and before Save; window persistence remained enabled for this Canvas CI child.

rust_clippy.cause: NativeOptions::default() followed by assignment to persist_window triggers clippy::field-reassign-with-default with -D warnings.
rust_clippy.planned_repair: Use NativeOptions { persist_window: policy_value, ..Default::default() } while preserving current product defaults.

linux_gtk.cause: GTK and OpenObsidian shared XDG_CONFIG_HOME/XDG_DATA_HOME inside the strict recursive snapshot root.
linux_gtk.planned_repair: Move XDG config/data parent directories to canonical run-scoped scratch roots outside the monitored tree; register and snapshot the exact OpenObsidian-owned descendants under stable logical prefixes, retaining complete marker and .ron checks without path allowlists.

windows_eframe.cause: A 2,937-byte app.ron appeared after Canvas text interaction while NativeOptions.persist_window remained true; the run is explicitly configured to reject every Windows app.ron.
windows_eframe.planned_repair: Add a distinct exact-value CI-only flag to disable both window and egui-memory persistence for only the normal Windows Canvas text-edit child; sanitize it from every other launch and retain the zero-app.ron policy.

macos_save_recovery.cause: The authorized existing-Canvas write creates an append-only prepared/committed journal and exact incoming/previous recovery snapshots under the app-owned per-vault data root.
macos_save_recovery.planned_repair: Keep pre-save snapshots byte-identical. At the confirmed save boundary validate exactly one new write operation, its prepared/committed journal entries, the selected relative Canvas path, revisions, confined regular recovery files, manifests, and previous/incoming byte counts and SHA-256 values. Require exact post-save app-data delta and unchanged post-close state; do not serialize journal, manifest, or Canvas contents.

notes: All required workflows and all jobs are terminal on the exact submitted SHA. Round-trip archive SHA-256 values match GitHub artifact API digests. Quality, inventory, and Rust CI published no artifacts. No source changes or same-SHA reruns were made after the batch.
